lines.text: Unless the Buyer has notified PPG otherwise, PPG understands, and Buyer represents that the products sold (1) will not be used in any nuclear, rocket systems, unmanned air
vehicles, or chemical or biological weapons application and (2), f end use or end user intormation diverted to another use or user. Buyer agrees to notify PPG immediately if
